test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

Rita said, "I am happy today."

options.text: Rita said that she is happy today.
Rita said that she was happy that day
Rita said that she had been happy that day.
Rita said that she was happy today.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Rita said that she was happy that day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronoun Change:**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" in direct speech is converted to "she" in indirect speech, matching the speaker.
 
 
 
• **Tense Change:**
 
 
• Present tense "am happy" is converted to past tense "was happy" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Time Reference Change:**
 
 
• "Today" in direct speech is changed to "that day" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Indirect speech uses "that" for reporting the statement.
 
• The sentence structure is adjusted to match the indirect speech format.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Rita said that she was happy that day.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Rita said that she is happy today. 

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "is" should be changed to "was" when converting to indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Rita said that she had been happy that day. 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "had been" implies a different context or earlier timeframe.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Rita said that she was happy today. 
 
 
• Incorrect time reference: "today" should be changed to "that day" in indirect speech.
